title: Norms in Conflict Adventure
meta_desc: Norms & Values Adventure 3 — KS3 Sociology on conflicting norms and values.
final_note: You learned how values can clash and how societies handle the conflict.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Sometimes values conflict:

  • Honesty vs loyalty (telling on a friend).
  • Tradition vs equality.
  • Liberty vs safety.

Tradition says: 'This is how we've always done it.'

Modern says: 'Times change.'

Both have value — and both can have a point.

Society uses:

  • Debate — talking it out.
  • Compromise — meeting in the middle.
  • Law — the final referee.

Disagreement isn't bad — how we handle it matters. 🤝
